description: A streamlined, offline-first API testing tool for VS Code. No login, no cloud, no limits.
configuration.historyMaxItems.descriptio: Maximum number of history entries to keep. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest unpinned entries are removed automatically.
Disable HTTPS certificate validation only for HTTPS requests that use self-signed certificates. Use this only when necessary.
configuration.displayLanguage.descriptio: Display language used by Tessra panels, prompts, notifications, and the in-app guide. The guide is localized only when a matching guide file exists; otherwise it falls back to English. VS Code settings labels and command titles still follow the VS Code locale.
configuration.requestPanelTheme.descript: Visual preset used by the Tessra request panel. Switch between the default polish, a minimal cool look, a stronger product feel, or bolder colors.
configuration.workspaceProfile.descripti: Workspace-local storage profile used for collections, history, environments, default headers, and saved tabs. Switch profiles to isolate Tessra data per project or workflow.
